melody:
IMPORTANT

This mod is a LIBRARY mod. 
It will do nothing on its own and its only purpose is to act as a dependency for other mods that use its features.

 About

Melody is an OpenAL-based client-side library mod for playing background music. 
It allows you to use OpenAL in Minecraft separated from Minecraft's sound engine and manager.

Melody allows you to (asynchronously) load audio files from all kinds of sources, including web sources.

It has built-in support for OGG and WAV audio files, but there's nothing stopping you from extending it to support more file types!

Since Melody was made for easily playing music in menus or in-world, it can't play directional sounds (sounds with a fixed origin in a 3D environment). It can only play 2D audio, so basically music.

To get an idea of how to create ready-to-play audio sources, take a look at Melody's SimpleAudioFactory class!

Everything

Alex’s Caves is a Forge mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 that adds 6 new cave biomes to the Overworld. Unlike most normal biomes, these cave biomes are exceedingly rare - yet they all contain a variety of unique blocks, items, mobs and mechanics that makes them considerable subterranean destinations. These six biomes are the Magnetic Caves, the Primordial Caves, the Toxic Caves, the Abyssal Chasm, the Forlorn Hollows and the Candy Cavity. 

 

To find any of these cave biomes, you’ll need to discover an Underground Cabin anywhere in the overworld. From there, you will find loot barrels with cave tablets and a Cave Compendium - a guide book for Alex’s Caves that should provide you with all the knowledge needed to find and explore any biome added by the mod. For more information on getting started, see the ‘Getting Started’ section on the mod’s wiki.

We will not upload this mod to CurseForge for personal reasons, we needn't explain. If the mod is ever uploaded on CurseForge again , it is not by our making and is a security issue, especially since CurseForge may silently switch to using it instead.

 Implemented features

 Features 

This mod adds extra JEI/REI/EMI categories that provides the following information:

- Shows the items mobs need to breed.
- Displays the spawn egg of the mob for easy lookup.
- Shows the number of eggs produced if the mob lays eggs after breeding.
- If the mob needs to be tamed before breeding, their name will have "(tamed)" added to it.

 

 Integrations

stackable127:
Stackable

Stackable is a mod that increases all block stacking limits to any value less than 127 for Minecraft 1.19.2-1.20.4 and 2.147B in 1.20.6+.

 Why 127?

Effectively, I'm lazy, but in reality, Minecraft stores all items with a single signed byte which for our purposes only can be between -128 to 127, since negative values are invalid that leaves a maximum stack size of 127. Moreover, this mod is intended to be compatible with other mods which may also use signed bytes to store items.

 Why make this mod
I don't know, other mods already exist that allow for stack sizes above 127. This was more for experimentation with creating mixins and understanding Minecrafts code a little better.

 Will you update to X?
Maybe.

 Will you backport to X?
Eh, not really.

 There's a bug here?
I might fix bugs that are Vanilla specific, but mod compatibility is gonna be kinda hard to do 

 Mod supp

faster-particle-collisions:
"Faster" Particle Collisions

Originally when writing Methane's 2.4 update, I found that particle lighting and collision calculations took up a lot of CPU time in certain conditions for seemingly no reason. To fix this, I outright disabled collision logic and lighting for particles when Methane was on. I've been meaning to throw this on modrinth for a while, and remembered to do it... a little later than expected. 

The lighting hack is very much a feature of Methane, although Particle Core optimizes lighting for particles (instead of throwing out the whole system for a bit more performance).

While this makes particles "more optimized", it also means that all particle collisions are not calculated . Most of the time this is not noticable, but particles that are meant to stick to surfaces will not do so anymore. A handful of other small effects will also look odd, or not work properly.

no-input-lag-tick-rate:
No Input Lag Tick Rate
Minecraft processes inputs every tick, making input latency inversely proportional to the tick rate (lower tick rate = higher latency). With a tick rate of 1 for example, your inputs are processed only once every second.

This mod moves input processing to the render loop, making input latency consistent regardless of the tick rate (assuming your frame rate is higher than 20 fps).

Here's a table for comparison:

 Tick Rate Input Latency (Vanilla) Input Latency (This Mod) 
 ---------- ------------------------- -------------------------- 
 20 tps (default) 50 ms 50 ms 
 10 tps 100 ms 50 ms 
 5 tps 200 ms 50 ms 
 1 tps 1000 ms 50 ms 

 Warning

This mod can trigger anticheats. Use it with caution on multiplayer servers.

When Mojang added environmental fog to the game, the time of day started affecting how fog looks underground. I thought this didn't make sense, so I made this mod.

This mod prevents fog from being affected by the time of day only when the player is underground . This lets you have the new environmental fog on the surface while keeping cave fog unaffected.

Check out the Gallery tab for comparison images between this mod, vanilla after environmental fog, and vanilla before environmental fog.

 Compatibility

- Supports every version which has environmental fog (1.21.6 and newer).
- Compatible with data packs and mods adding custom fog colors to cave biomes, through biome fog colors before 1.21.11 and environment attributes since 1.21.11. A cave biome is any biome in the vanilla cave biome list or the c:is cave / c:is underground biome tags. Custom fog colors are kept

Modern Mayhem

Modern Mayhem is a mod focused on adding realistic and authentic military equipment while keeping a perfect stylization balance between Vanilla Minecraft and popular military mods, namely TacZ, which also received full compatibility with the mod.

---

 Features

 Equipment
Included are different equipment pieces, such as body armors , backpacks , NVGs and much more.

 Data-Driven
Modern Mayhem is fully data-driven . Every piece of equipment is defined through content packs, so new gear can be added with just GeckoLib models and JSON files, no code required . Modpack makers and artists can create their own equipment or tweak the existing ones without touching the mod itself.

 Fully Configurable
Every piece of equipment has many variants which are all entirely configurable, allowing you to alter aspects such as:
- Armor points

Introduction

Numerous Minecraft mods have integrated functional features within both 2D and 3D environments[1][2][3], yet brute-force methods frequently prove inefficient. In this regard, we introduce Tetrachord Lib, a lightweight library modification designed to optimize diverse data structures.

 Related Works

 Server-side Optimization Mods

jellysquid3 [4] introduced Lithium, a groundbreaking optimization mod that enhances various facets of Minecraft servers. Employing precise algorithms to minimize chunk and block access, this mod enhances not only world generation but also AI for mobs, collision detection, discovery of points of interests (poi), and other crucial aspects to boost computational efficiency and decrease milliseconds per tick (mspt) of servers.

Spottedstar[5] introduced Starlight, an innovative modification that redefines the light engine of Minecraft to improve perf

介绍 许多Minecraft模组已经在2D和3D环境中集成了功能特性[1][2][3]，但是暴力的方法经常被证明是低效的。在这方面，我们引入了Tetracord Lib，一个轻量级的库修改，旨在优化不同的数据结构。 相关作品 服务器端最佳化模组 jellysquid 3 [4]推出了Lithium，这是一个突破性的优化模组，它可以增强Minecraft服务器的各个方面。该模组采用精确的算法来最大限度地减少区方块访问，不仅可以增强世界生成，还可以增强小怪的AI、冲突检测、兴趣点（poi）的发现以及其他关键方面，从而提高计算效率并减少服务器的毫秒/节拍（mspt）。 Spotlight [5]推出了Starlight，这是一个创新的修改，重新定义了Minecraft的光引擎，以提高性能。

Sculk Transporting allows the transportation of items via sculk signals. Explodee
 
Explodee changes the Minecraft explosion code to propagate in a spherical formation instead of a cubic formation. This results in less raycasts being used for smaller explosions (TNT uses 100 raycasts instead of ~1000) and more at higher radii.

 Note: Explodee explosions do not work exactly like vanilla explosions (i.e. there is a possibility that some neighboring TNT may not ignite if it is 3 blocks away) . Explodee explosions are also visually very different, especially at larger explosion radii.

Explodee works with Lithium (taking advantage of its explosion optimizations), it is recommended to use Lithium with Explodee if you are on Fabric or Neoforge.

simple-close-button:
Simple Close Button

Adds a close button to inventory screens. As of version 3.0, you can add and remove which screens have the button, as well as change it's position and it should work with all vanilla-based implementations of a recipe book, all through the Mod Menu config, made with YACL.

Keep in mind that you will need to know the class path of whichever screen, vanilla or modded, that you want to add a button to in the config.

If you are just a casual user, you shouldn't have to worry about any of that, though. All the vanilla screens that this mod should apply to are included by default.

If you wish to make (and distibute) a resource pack that changes the textures of the button, feel free to do so. The textures are stored under /assets/close-btn/textures/gui/sprites/widget/. The indevidual textures are named "close button.png" and "close button highlighted.png".

Respawn Delay is a mod designed for servers. It fits best in a pvp server, but can be used in events as well. Instead of instantly respawning, players enter spectator mode on death. They can fly around and see the action, until the configurable delay has been reached and they respawn. All messages sent are configurable, but by default the spectating player will receive an update on when they will respawn every second counting down. There is also a /respawnall command to force all spectating players to respawn. Respawn delay is compatible with Gravestone mods. Just make sure to disable dropItemsOnDeath in the config to prevent duplication.

accurate-maps:
Accurate Maps

A small quality of life mod that changes the vanilla map coloring to be more accurate to in-game colors.

 

 Showcase

 

Accurate Maps works by sending extra info to the client about the block being represented in the map. With that extra info, the client can then calculate the color of the block in a more accurate way. 

If the map being rendered does not have additional info, the renderer will fall back to the vanilla colors, so mods that use the vanilla map system to render custom stuff will not be affected.

 Resource Pack Support

 

Since we're sampling the color directly from the block texture instead of a predefined list of colors, resource packs are fully supported.

 Other information

For bug reporting please proceed to the mod's GitHub repository: https://github.com/lucaargolo/accurate-maps

If you have any other questions or suggestions, feel free to call me

Rose Gold Alloy 
A warm, elegant mid-tier metal for builders, adventurers and enchantment enjoyers.

Rose Gold Alloy introduces a handcrafted metal that sits perfectly between Iron and Diamond. 
It does not generate in the world — you must forge it. By combining Copper, Gold and the crystalline spark of Amethyst, players unlock a new material with style, strength and purpose.

This mod focuses on progression, craftsmanship and a smooth, rewarding mid-game experience.

----------------------------------------------

 What is Rose Gold?

Rose Gold is a refined alloy created by skilled players, not stumbled upon as ore. 
It blends the warmth of copper, the purity of gold and the magical clarity of amethyst into a metal that feels precious but grounded — powerful but not overpowered.

As a tier, Rose Gold fills the gap where Iron starts to feel weak and Diamond feels too expensive to break.

focus-revolution:
Focus Revolution

 Manual focus control for Iris shaders

Focus Revolution is a client-side Minecraft mod that lets you control the depth-of-field focus of Iris shaders manually. It is designed for streaming, machinima, cinematic recordings, and screenshots.

Shader packs normally focus automatically on whatever is near the center of the screen. This works well during regular gameplay, but it can be inconvenient when filming because the focus may change as you move the crosshair. Focus Revolution lets you take control of the focus, move it smoothly to the position you want, and return to automatic focus when you are finished.

 

 
Shot with Complementary Reimagined

 Features

 Feature Description 
 --- ---

What is Offline Player Cache?

Offline Player Cache (OPC) is a Minecraft API mod built using the Fabric framework to allow caching player data on the server while the player is offline. This means that mods can use this API to access offline player's data. This was primarily developed as a way to allow global and persistent leaderboards for Minecraft servers that included offline players.

 Specific Capabilities

Mods can register functions that take in a player and output a value/object; this value/object is limited only by what is specified in the key's read/write to/from nbt data. When a player disconnects from a server, all registered functions are called and the respective data is cached on the server before the player disconnects. This is a visualization mod that renders detailed information about ScheduledTicks in the world, including their type, trigger time, order, and priority.
 How to Use?
First, make sure to install YACL and Mod Menu, and ensure this mod is installed on both the server and the client. 
Then, enter the world, open the settings menu, navigate to Mod Menu, find this mod, and click on its settings. Enable "Main Render" to start visualizing ScheduledTicks.

 

 Related Commands and Settings
Settings are already explained in the configuration menu and won't be elaborated on here. However, it's worth noting that to prevent the server from sending ScheduledTick data for distant areas (very far away) to the client, the server will check whether any players are within range (default is 20 blocks). /gamerule scheduledTickInformationRange

light-core:
LightCore
LightCore is a lightweight, client-side performance logger for Minecraft that samples FPS and key system metrics, then converts them into a clear score, tier, and ranking—so you can understand what’s driving low performance.
 What it measures
LightCore collects periodic performance snapshots containing:
- Client FPS (averaged over a short rolling window)
- JVM memory usage (heap used / heap max)
- Physical memory usage (used / total)
- CPU load (percent) and CPU core count
- OS/architecture/Java version metadata (for context)
 Scoring, tiers, and ranking
Each snapshot is analyzed into:
- Score (0–100): a weighted evaluation based on FPS plus penalties from memory pressure, CPU load, and CPU core context
- Tier: Excellent , Good , Average , or Low 
- Hint: a short, actionable message (e.g., low FPS, high CPU load, or high memory pressure)
- Rank: where the current snapshot stand

Smart Copper Golem

English 简体中文 繁體中文

 This mod is implemented entirely server-side; the client only provides Mod Menu integration.

Mojang has been extremely cautious when it comes to "benefiting players," and the Copper Golem is a prime example.

They were designed to move only a very small number of items from one chest to another with a simple traversal. Once they encounter an item that cannot be inserted, they can fall into an endless loop.

Smart Copper Golem aims to give Copper Golems smarter behavior so they can manage items more efficiently.

 Features

 🧠 Deep Memory

 When accessing a chest, a Copper Golem remembers the types of items inside.
 When picking up items from the Copper Chest, a Copper Golem prioritizes items that exist in its memory.
 Copper Golems exchange memories with each other, making collective learning more efficient.

 🎯 Target Selection

Vanilla enchanting rolls random stats and magic into one messy system. This mod splits everything into three clean systems where every choice matters.

The enchanting table opens a catalogue instead of rolling random enchantments. Pick your enchantment, pay a thematic reagent and some XP. ChestSee is a lightweight Fabric chest logger for Minecraft servers. It logs chests, barrels, shulker boxes and other containers to simple .txt files. Drop it in, no setup needed. Look up logs in-game with /chestsee , or open the files in your world folder.

Server-side only. Vanilla clients can join.

 

 How it works

The mod runs on the server and tracks every time a player opens a container and changes its contents. It also logs when someone breaks a container or places a hopper underneath one.

Logs are saved as .txt files under ChestLog/ in your world folder, sorted by dimension. Each container gets its own file, named after the block type and coordinates. Moving containers (minecarts, chest boats) use their entity UUID instead.

 Logged containers 

Chests, barrels, shulker boxes, hoppers, dispensers, droppers, crafters, furnaces, blast furnaces, smokers, brewing stands, chest/hop

Barricades

Barricades is a lightweight mod that adds wooden barricades to the game. That's it, really.

 A 16-pack of barricades can be crafted by placing 2 planks diagonally next to each other in a crafting grid.

 Usage

Hold a Barricade and right click to a wall to place a barricade. Barricades are a unique type of entity as they do not take any sort of damage from vanilla/modded damage sources. A barricade has 5HP (if you don't know what that means, think of it like 5 hearts but you'll always deal one heart damage). When a barricade breaks, it will drop nothing.

Zombies can break barricades on any difficulty, and they will do it faster depending on the difficulty. Here is a detailed table:

 Difficulty Cooldown 
 ------------ -------------------- 
 Peaceful N/A 
 Easy 20 ticks (1sec) 
 Normal 15 ticks (0.75sec) 
 Hard 10 ticks (0.5sec)

🌼 Persistent Mooshroom Flowers

 Never re‑flower your brown mooshrooms again! 
This lightweight mod lets a brown mooshroom keep the effect of the very first flower you give it—no matter how many times you milk it for suspicious stew.

---

 How it Works
1. Feed a flower to a brown mooshroom . 
2. The mooshroom is “locked” to that flower’s stew effect permanently . 
3. Harvest suspicious stew as often as you like—the flower is not consumed .

---

 Changing the Flower (Reset Method)
If you want to assign a different flower:

1. Convert the brown mooshroom into a red mooshroom (e.g., lightning). 
2. Milk the red mooshroom once to clear any residual stew data with a bowl. 
3. Convert it back into a brown mooshroom . 
4. Feed a new flower to lock in a new effect.

---

 Why You’ll Love It
- ✨ Quality‑of‑Life – carry one flower instead of stacks. 
- 🔧 Simple – no new items, blocks, or GUIs.

no-iron-golems-spawn:
Disable Villager Golem Spawns Mod
This Fabric mod disables the spawning of iron golems caused by villagers, spawn eggs, or commands. This can especially be helpful when building a city and you want to prevent unwanted golem spawns.

 Iron golems can only be spawned by building them manually. 
 Features
- Prevents iron golems from being spawned by villagers, spawn eggs, or commands. Can only be spawned by building them manually.
- Adds the 
 /golemcount command (available from version 1.0.1-1.21.4) for server operators to track how many villager-spawned golems have been prevented. Requires OP level 2 or higher.

 Requirements
- This mod requires Fabric API to work. 
- This is a server-side mod only. Players connecting to a server with this mod do not need it installed on their client.

ores-renewed:
Ores Renewed

Ores Renewed adds eight brand new ore types to Minecraft, bringing fresh variety to resource gathering. Each ore generates both in regular stone and as a deepslate variant, spreading their spawn locations across different height levels of the world.

The mod introduces Uranium, Titanium, Ruby, Lead, Killium, Magnetite, Vulkanite, and Blackcristal. Most of these materials come with a full progression from raw ore to ingot to a compact storage block, making it easy to stockpile larger amounts. All ores and resources are also accessible through their own dedicated creative mode tab.

There are complite tool setz für Vulkanit, Ruby and Titan and pickaxes für Magnetit and Lead and a Killium Swort

The Fabric Loader and Fabric API are required.

Found a bug or have an idea for more ores? Feedback and suggestions are always welcome at oresrenewed@gmail.com.

Cinematic Flow is a mod that helps you create cinematic camera movements between points in your world. Instead of walking or flying to show off your builds, you can set up a path that automatically moves your camera while you sit back and watch.

 How It Works

The mod gives you a set of tools in your inventory when you use the /cinema start command. These items let you:

- Set markers at different locations in your world
- Remove markers if you place them in the wrong spot 
- Set a focus point that your camera will look at during movement
- Edit individual markers to control timing and names
- Adjust settings for different movement styles

Once you've placed at least two markers, use the start item to begin recording your cinematic. Your camera will move from marker to marker.

Hello! This is my first (of hopefully many!) mods for Minecraft! 

The goal of this mod is to provide Glistering Melon Slices as a good mid-end game food source on par with golden carrots, as prior they have little to no use outside of brewing potions (and distracting piglins!)

 "uncommons": [

Corpse Scavengers

When a player dies, the location is marked with an invisible anchor. Nearby hostile mobs within a 32-block radius will pathfind toward that spot over the next few minutes.

 Mob Behavior

Mobs that reach the death location and linger there briefly will consume the lingering essence, gaining:
- Permanent strength boost
- Slightly increased health

These effects stack if multiple players have died nearby, creating dangerous hotspots where mobs become noticeably more formidable.

 Details

- Invisible markers are placed as armor stands and despawn after 5 minutes if not consumed
- Scavenger mobs: Zombies, skeletons, spiders
- Non-scavengers: Creepers (ignore death sites)

- Encourages players to either avoid repeat deaths or clear out empowered mobs before they become overwhelming

painters-eye:
---
 
 Requires CIT Resewn or OptiFine for 1.21.4 and below! 

 

---
 What is Painter's Eye?
 

Beginning in Minecraft 1.19.4, you could get a painting item that places a specific variant from the Creative Mode Inventory rather than having to keep replacing the paintings you place trying to get the right one. The only issue with this was that every painting had the same texture, making it very tedious to find the right one you needed.

freeguys-gear:
I always thought that tools in minecraft were a little bland, you know, all of them reuse the exact same sprites, just with different colors. Even mechanically all of them are exactly the same, just that one deals more damage than the other, and i wanted to change that.

Then i came up with a concept for a combat/balance update where, for example - diamond tools were all about sharpness and precision, so a pickaxe has built-in nerfed silk touch and the sword applies a "bleeding" effect. Netherite tools are all about being heavy - the pickaxe breaks nearby blocks, the sword applies a stun or darkness effect. Copper tools can be charged with a lighting, meaning - the pickaxe when charged, automatically smelts ores, Etc.

And then i made sprites to go along with that concept and eventually it de-evolved into this resourcepack. 

So, enjoy!

我一直认为Minecraft中的工具有点乏味，你知道，所有的工具都重复使用完全相同的精灵，只是颜色不同。即使在机械上，它们也完全相同，只是一个比另一个造成更多的伤害，我想改变这一点。 然后我想出了一个战斗/平衡更新的概念，例如-金刚石工具都是关于锋利和精确的，所以鹤嘴锄内置了削弱的丝绸触感，剑施加了"流血"效果。Netherite工具都是关于沉重的-鹤嘴锄打破附近的方块，剑施加了眩晕或黑暗效果。铜工具可以用闪电充电，意思是-鹤嘴锄充电时，自动冶炼矿石，等等。 然后我做了精灵来沿着这个概念，最后它演变成了这个资源包。 好好享受吧!

Chara’s Vibrant Shaders feels like a world turned up too far—colors too bright, light too intense, everything just a little unstable. Greens glow almost unnaturally, water shimmers like liquid glass, and the sky bleeds vivid shades into the horizon. It’s beautiful in a loud, overwhelming way, like reality trying to outdo itself.

But it never quite settles. Light flickers when it shouldn’t, shadows shift unpredictably, and parts of the world seem to glitch or warp for a moment before snapping back. Sometimes it looks broken—other times, accidentally perfect.

It’s vibrant, messy, and unpredictable. Like something that wasn’t meant to work, but somehow does anyway.

It's very buggy with contrast and night time but during the day it works out. the godrays are also very buggy.

﻿Ottonien ist ein historischer Minecraft-Mittelalter-RPG-Server mit lebendigem Roleplay. Erlebe eine authentische Welt des 14. Jahrhunderts und erkunde das Herzogtum.
Elfen, Zwerge, Drachen und andere Ammenmärchen suchst du hier vergeblich. Stattdessen erwartet dich eine detailverliebte Nachbildung der mittelalterlichen Gesellschaft des 14. Jahrhunderts. Frei von den Klischees des düsteren Mittelalters und mit einem Fokus auf Roleplay, liegt es bei dir, deinen Platz in der ständischen Ordnung einzunehmen.

 Features 
Erlebe historischen Realismus und Rollenspiel
Ein wahrhaftes RPG in Minecraft durch Custom-Plugins, kein Server von der Stange
Eigenes Server-Resourcepack
Mittelalterlicher Skincreator/Charaktereditor
Spannende Lore, Quests und spielergenerierte Macht
